title: I Let An AI Hack My Own App Before A Real Hacker Could
description:
Strix is an open source AI penetration testing tool with 59,000 stars on GitHub. Instead of running a scan and handing you a list of possible bugs, it deploys agents that behave like real attackers, break into your running app, and only report a vulnerability once they have actually exploited it, with a suggested fix attached. Everything runs in a Docker sandbox on your own machine.

Only ever run it against an app you own or have written permission to test.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TPPqfar0mEaW4o2fsnTrsLs6FyBFcB0QtaMX5s0GBac/edit?usp=sharing
